title: Rounds and Cantwell Seek Trump Administration AI Cybersecurity Strategy
summary:
The White House has been pressed by bipartisan senators to adopt a coordinated federal response to the growing security threats linked to artificial intelligence. Senators Mike Rounds and Maria Cantwell sent a letter to the Trump administration calling for a unified national strategy that centers on rigorous AI testing and auditing standards.

The request for executive action follows a period where congressional movement on AI safety legislation has lagged. The senators specifically urged the administration to create a federal framework to mitigate the cybersecurity vulnerabilities that emerge as AI systems are deployed across the country.
